caption: The drawing features a central horse-drawn carriage carrying four figures, with two horses in front, all rendered in shades of grey with brown outlines. The carriage is positioned toward the right side of the composition and sits on two large wheels. There are two standing figures next to the carriage, also shaded in grey and brown, while another figure stands apart at the far left under a tree. The scene is set outdoors, with trees featuring rich brown and dark green foliage framing both sides of the image. The background is filled with a solid yellow color, and the ground is a mix of green, brown, and grey tones, creating the effect of grass and earth. Several birds, depicted in similar muted tones, are visible in the right portion of the image among the trees. All elements are outlined and shaded to provide depth, but the palette remains limited to earthy tones, with an overall stylized and flat rendering to the composition.
title: Wallpaper from Bandbox
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
